description.full_text: The image shows a metallic suitcase with a ribbed texture placed on a tiled floor. It has four wheels and a top handle. The suitcase is positioned in front of a grey upholstered sofa. The visible text on the suitcase's lock reads "RIMOWA." The scene is indoors and has a calm, neutral atmosphere.
